|strategy=The [[Corellian]], [[Dash Rendar]], is a skilled card player, pilot, and smuggler. He arrived in his ship, the [[Outrider]], at Echo Base just before the Empire invaded. Rendar then flew a snowspeeder against the Imperial walker attack in the Battle of [[Hoth (location){{!}}Hoth]].

[[Leia Organa]] later hired Rendar to help protect [[Luke Skywalker]]. Interested more in doing the job that he was hired for than in any altruistic endeavors, the [[Corellian]] nevertheless found himself embroiled in their affairs.<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/reflections2/light/small/dashrendar.html</ref>
